entry.title: Georgia Tech Satellite Launched by NASA and SpaceX, Students Run Mission Control from Campus

media:group.media:title: Georgia Tech Satellite Launched by NASA and SpaceX, Students Run Mission Control from Campus
media:group.media:description: A satellite created at Georgia Tech is now in space after a successful launch aboard the @SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket. A group of Yellow Jacket students is set to operate the @NASA spacecraft from mission control on campus. The CubeSat is testing next-generation propulsion technology during a nine-month mission.

entry.title: How Ancient Humans Tracking the Equinox Shaped Our Modern Day Calendar

media:group.media:title: How Ancient Humans Tracking the Equinox Shaped Our Modern Day Calendar
media:group.media:description: The autumnal equinox isn't a date on your calendar. Your calendar exists because of the equinox. Georgia Tech's Observatory Director Paul Sell explains how celestial motions — like the equinox — were critical to human civilization's understanding and documentation of time.

entry.title: Georgia Tech | Whatever It Is (2026 PSA)

media:group.media:title: Georgia Tech | Whatever It Is (2026 PSA)
media:group.media:description:
Whatever it is, it is never new to us.
At Georgia Tech, we’ve been applying it, questioning it, and improving it — responsibly —since 1885. Because progress starts at Tech.
The Georgia Institute of Technology is a top public research university in Atlanta, with more than 53,000 students from 146 countries. Offering degrees in engineering, computing, business, design, liberal arts, and sciences, Georgia Tech conducts over $1B in annual research that drives innovation, advances STEM education, and fuels economic growth in Georgia and beyond.

media:group.media:title: Georgia Tech New Student Convocation 2026
media:group.media:description: This event serves as the Institute's official welcome to the campus community. The event will inspire our students to work to reach their highest potential while at Tech, acquaint new students with Georgia Tech's mission and traditions, and build camaraderie amongst the newest class of students.

media:group.media:title: Institute Address 2026
media:group.media:description: President Ángel Cabrera will highlight recent Institute achievements, convey his vision and goals for the upcoming academic year, and answer audience questions. The entire campus community is invited to attend this event in-person in the Walter G. Ehmer Theater, or online on president.gatech.edu.

entry.title: Join us for Avant South on Oct. 12 - 13

media:group.media:title: Join us for Avant South on Oct. 12 - 13
media:group.media:description: As Atlanta’s premier tech and innovation event, Avant South continues to advance the city’s position as a leading hub for innovation, convening founders, executives, investors, policymakers, researchers, and students. This year, we’re diving into our theme: AI in Action. From logistics and fintech to healthcare and media, we’ll explore how AI is actively transforming the industries that define Atlanta’s growth, and how leaders across sectors are putting AI to work in real, practical ways. entry.title: The Future of Critical Minerals with Dr. Yuanzhi Tang

media:group.media:title: The Future of Critical Minerals with Dr. Yuanzhi Tang
media:group.media:description: Critical minerals are at the heart of the energy transition. In this conversation, Georgia Tech's Dr. Yuanzhi Tang explains how innovative research is helping secure the resources needed for tomorrow's batteries, electronics, and advanced manufacturing.

entry.title: Progress That Powers Georgia | 2026 Georgia Tech Summer State Tour

media:group.media:title: Progress That Powers Georgia | 2026 Georgia Tech Summer State Tour
media:group.media:description: Georgia Tech is powering the industries that move Georgia forward. President Ángel Cabrera’s Summer Tour offered a firsthand look at Georgia Tech’s work in action across the state —highlighting how the Institute’s research, talent, and partnerships strengthen the industries driving Georgia’s economy. Checkout the tour recap at https://president.gatech.edu/summer-tour-2026. Across the entire state, Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets are strengthening Georgia’s leading industries and small businesses, protecting our troops, addressing critical national challenges, creating jobs and advancing technologies that fuel our state’s economy and global competitiveness.

entry.title: The Artist Behind the Role - Jackets of all Trades : Malena Bisanti

media:group.media:title: The Artist Behind the Role - Jackets of all Trades : Malena Bisanti
media:group.media:description:
In this episode of Jackets of All Trades, we meet Malena Bisanti, a creative professional in Georgia Tech’s College of Lifetime Learning. Blending her artistic perspective with her work in higher education, Malena shares how her experiences shape her approach—connecting creativity, purpose, and impact at the Institute.
